paite: TOUPA aw, ka thumna ngaikia inla; hehpih ka ngetna ah bildoh in; na ginomna ziak leh na diktatna ziak in hon dawng in.
heading: David Phatna La / Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

paite: Na sikha tung ah vaihawm ke'n; na mitmuh ah mihing himhim siamtang a om ding lah a-om kei uhi.
english: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

paite: Melma in ka hinna asimmoh a; ka hinna lei ah asatpuk a; sawtpi a sisa bang in, mun mialte ah hon omsak hi.
english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

paite: Huaiziak in ka sung ah ka kha abah a, ka sung ah ka lungtang amangbang hi.
english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

paite: Nidanglai nite ka theigige a; na thilhihte teng ka ngaihtuah zel a na khut nasepte ka sut zel hi.
english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

paite: Ka khutte nang lam ah ka zak zel a, ka hinna, gam zawngkhaltak bang in, nangmah ah adangtak hi. Selah
english: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon dawng meng in, ka kha abah hi; kei a pan na mai sel ke'n; huchi lou in zaw kokhuk a paisukte bang lel in ka na om kha ding hi.
english: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

paite: Zingsang in na zahngaihna thu hon theisak in; nang lah ka hon muang ngal a, ka paina ding lampi hon theisak in; ka lungsim lah na kiang ah ka koihkip zel ngal a.
english: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

paite: TOUPA aw hon doute lak ah hon humbit in; na hon na sel ding in na kiang ah ka hong tai hi.
english: Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

paite: Na deihlam hih hon kisinsak in; ka Pathian lah na hi ngal a; na kha hoih in lamphei ah hon pi zel hen.
english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

paite: TOUPA aw, na min ziak in hon hihhalh inla; na diktatna ziak in ka hinna mangbatna a kipan pikhia in.
english: Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

paite: Na zahngaihna ziak in hon doute hihmang inla, ka hinna hihmangbangte tengteng hihmang in; na sikha ka hi uhi.
english: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.
